translations.translatedText: # Saturday 25.6.2022 (radio)
Mass shooting in Norway. The police's Midsummer. Midsummer festivals. Ukraine. Weather forecast.
Mass shooting in Norway
![Police guarding a street in Oslo.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_8172,h_4596,x_0,y_506/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97453162b6e3bd79060/1656153040)
Open image viewer
Police guarding a street in Oslo. Photo: Javad Parsa / EPA

A mass shooting has taken place in Norway. The mass shooting happened in the Norwegian capital Oslo early on Saturday morning. The mass shooting took place on a busy bar street. 2 people died and about 20 people were injured in the mass shooting.

The police caught the shooter. The shooter is a 42-year-old man. The shooter is a Norwegian citizen. He was born in Iran. Norwegian authorities charge the shooter with terrorism, murder and attempted murder.
From Finland, President Sauli Niinistö and Prime Minister Sanna Marin have expressed condolences to the victims' relatives.
## The police's Midsummer

![Chief Constable Timo Kokkonen (left) and Senior Constable Petri Kuiri next to their patrol boat at Pirttiniemi in Kuopio.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3950,h_2221,x_0,y_270/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97371662b30e39a2631/1655901976)
Open image viewer
Chief Constable Timo Kokkonen and Senior Constable Petri Kuiri patrol on Lake Kallavesi. Photo: Jukka Eskanen / Yle
Finns are now celebrating Midsummer. The police had a busy night between Friday and Saturday. Almost 12,000 calls came to the emergency centres on Midsummer Eve, Friday.

The police had many tasks to investigate, for example disorderly behaviour and assaults. People who drove a car or boat while drunk also kept the police busy. However, no serious crimes or accidents happened.
However, at least 2 people have drowned at Midsummer.
## Midsummer festivals
![Audience at the Himos festival.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5119,h_2879,x_0,y_533/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-97440562b57772dc274/1656059790)
Open image viewer
Audience at the Himos festival. Photo: Tommi Anttonen / Lehtikuva

The Midsummer festivals are going well now. For example, in Central Finland 30,000 people take part in the Himos Midsummer festival over 3 days, which is a normal number of people. Last year only half, that is 15,000 people, were allowed into Himos because of corona restrictions.
In North Savo about 15,000 people take part in the Tahko Midsummer festival. That is a record number, that is, more people than have previously attended the Tahko Midsummer festival.
People want to go to Midsummer festivals and other summer events again, because the corona restrictions have ended.
## Ukraine
![Satellite image of destruction in Chernihiv.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_8794,h_4946,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-932379623be16f8b856/1648105020)
Open image viewer
In March a large oil tank burned in Chernihiv. Photo: Maxar Technologies / EPA
Russia has made several missile strikes on the northern parts of Ukraine.

Ukraine says that Russia has struck, for example, near the city of Zhytomyr and in the town of Desna in the Chernihiv region. The governor of the Chernihiv region says that most of the missiles were fired at Chernihiv from Belarus.
Belarus is not part of the war, but Belarus lets Russia use Belarusian territory.
## The weather
![Sunday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12510768)
Open image viewer
The weather is warm and sunny on Sunday too.
Warm summer weather continues in Finland.
Only in Central Lapland will there be showers or thunder showers on Sunday. Elsewhere it is sunny.
The temperature on Sunday is between 25 and 30 degrees; in Northern Lapland it is cooler.
